white-hover.displayName: Pure White (hover state only: nav, index rows, [ Visit ], channel links, the Talk email band, a Prove shelf object on hover or open)

display.purpose: The one word each stage owns. Hero: the name, always two lines. Build / Ship / Prove / Talk: `Build.` / `Ship.` / `Prove.` / `Talk.`, one line.

display-mobile.purpose: The display role at 720px and below; the Hero name and the Build, Ship, Prove and Talk words step to it. Second stop of the display ramp, not a separate voice.

display-compact.purpose: The Display step for a pinned desktop stage that must hold everything in one short viewport: `Prove.` between 741px and 820px of viewport height, with the shelf objects at zoom 0.85. Same 96px floor as Display, lower ceiling. Recorded on the detector's advisory.

display-band.purpose: Third stop of the display ramp, used once: the email address in the Talk band, repeated three times between two hairlines with a mute em-dash separator (0.3em padding) between repeats and none after the last. Ink at rest, pure white on hover. Never a headline.

display-band-mobile.purpose: The band step at 720px and below and under prefers-reduced-motion: the address shown once, static, breaking only after the @ via <wbr>; repeats and separators hidden.

body.purpose: Reserved reading voice, loaded on <body> at weights 400/500. No size, leading or measure set on any surface yet.

descriptor.purpose: The one mono sentence beside the stage word: Hero descriptor above the name, Build pitch under the print. Sentence case, mute. Measure 54ch in both stages.

index.purpose: Project names in the Build index (mute, ink when active) and the role title of each Ship frame (ink, weight 400). Sentence case; Build names bracketed on mobile.

label.purpose: Bracketed controls: navigation, the DZ mark, the [ Visit host ] link, the Talk channel controls ([ GitHub ] [ X ] [ LinkedIn ] [ Instagram ]) and the [ Open ] control in a Prove tag. The only uppercase role; its one non-control use is the Prove shelf label (Won / Shared / Certified), an engraving at the right end of a board.

data.purpose: Data and measurements: the scope column of the Build index, the Ship year labels, the organisation and dates in each Ship frame, the Talk sign-off (© {year} David Zapata · davidzo.com), and the Prove tag's name (ink) and detail · year (mute). Sentence case, tabular numerals. Build scope and year labels hidden on mobile; frame dates stay.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The only easing. Used by the develop/settle load animation and the 200ms hover colour step.

motion.name: develop
motion.value: 1.6s var(--ease-out) both; from { filter: brightness(0.05) contrast(1.6) } to { filter: brightness(1) contrast(1) }
motion.purpose: The photograph rises once from near-black to its true tones on load. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: settle
motion.value: 1.6s var(--ease-out) both; from { transform: translateY(24px) } to { transform: none }
motion.purpose: The copy block (descriptor + name) settles up 24px into place alongside develop. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: hover-step
motion.purpose: Text controls (nav links, index rows, [ Visit ], channel links, the Talk email band) step from mute (or ink, for the band) to pure white. Transition removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: develop-on-change
motion.value: same keyframes as develop, applied to the active print in the Build window whenever the active project changes
motion.purpose: Every print change on a stage rises from near-black exactly like the Hero's load moment. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: smooth-scroll
motion.value: Lenis ({ autoRaf: false, anchors: true }) driven by gsap.ticker; lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update); lagSmoothing(0); index/anchor jumps scrollTo(y, { duration: 0.9 })
motion.purpose: One clock for scroll smoothing and scrubbing. Not created under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: stage-pin
motion.value: ScrollTrigger { start: 'top top', end: '+=' + innerHeight * steps, pin: true, scrub: true, anticipatePin: 1 }; active step = floor(progress * steps)
motion.purpose: A stage with several steps stays one pinned viewport and is scrubbed by scroll. Desktop (min-width 721px) and no-preference only.

motion.name: hero-exit
motion.value: gsap.to(photo, { yPercent: -8, filter: 'brightness(0.08)', ease: 'none', scrollTrigger: { start: 'top top', end: 'bottom top', scrub: true } })
motion.purpose: As the Hero unpins its print sinks toward the ground and eases up 8% while the next word rises. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: strip-scrub
motion.value: gsap.to(track, { x: () => -(track.scrollWidth - (innerWidth - 2*gutter)), ease: 'none', scrollTrigger: { start: 'top top', end: () => '+=' + distance*1.2, pin: true, scrub: true, anticipatePin: 1, invalidateOnRefresh: true } })
motion.purpose: Second pin grammar (Ship): the pinned stage drags a horizontal strip right-to-left by the scroll until its last label lands on the right gutter. Desktop (min-width 721px) and no-preference only. Talk reuses it as band-scrub.

motion.name: axis-draw
motion.value: gsap.from(axis, { scaleX: 0, transformOrigin: 'left center', duration: 1.2, ease: CustomEase.create('davidzo-out', '0.16,1,0.3,1'), scrollTrigger: { start: 'top 70%', once: true } })
motion.purpose: The Ship timeline axis draws once from the left on first entry and never again. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion. Uses the system's --ease-out bezier (0.16,1,0.3,1) registered as a GSAP CustomEase, so CSS and GSAP share one curve.

motion.name: band-scrub
motion.value: gsap.to(band, { x: () => -(band.scrollWidth - innerWidth), ease: 'none', scrollTrigger: { start: 'top top', end: () => '+=' + Math.max(distance*1.2, innerHeight*0.6), pin: true, scrub: true, anticipatePin: 1, invalidateOnRefresh: true } })
motion.purpose: The distance grammar on Talk's full-bleed email band: translated by its overflow past the viewport (no gutter subtracted), pin length distance x 1.2 with a floor of 0.6 x innerHeight so a short overflow still holds the stage. Desktop (min-width 721px) and no-preference only; the CSS forces transform: none on mobile and under reduced motion.

motion.name: shelf-reveal
motion.value: gsap.timeline({ defaults: { ease: CustomEase('0.16,1,0.3,1') }, scrollTrigger: { start: 'top top', end: () => '+=' + innerHeight * (0.7 * shelves + 0.4), pin: true, scrub: true, anticipatePin: 1, invalidateOnRefresh: true } }); per shelf at i*1.4: board fromTo scaleX 0→1 (origin left center, 1s); objects fromTo y -14→0, opacity 0.25→1 (0.9s, stagger 0.12) at +0.2; label fromTo opacity 0.25→1 (0.6s) at +0.5; then an empty 0.6s beat
motion.purpose: Third pin grammar (Prove): the pinned stage sets its shelves down one after another as the visitor scrubs. Requires min-width 721px, min-height 741px and no-preference.

motion.name: shelf-reveal-once
motion.value: same reveal per shelf on its own timeline; scrollTrigger { trigger: shelf, start: 'top 82%', once: true }
motion.purpose: On a desktop shorter than 741px and on phones (max-width 720px), unpinned: each shelf is set down once as it enters. Nothing under prefers-reduced-motion; the shelves are simply there.

motion.name: tag-open
motion.value: opacity 0→1, transform translateY(-8px)→none, 0.2s var(--ease-out); object color ink→#fff 0.2s var(--ease-out)
motion.purpose: A Prove tag drops into place under its object on hover, focus (fine pointers) or first tap; the object steps to pure white. Transitions removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: portrait band crop, nav collapses to DZ + [ Talk ], scroll cue hidden; Build unpinned, height auto, single column, 2x2 bracketed index, 4:3 print window. Ship unpinned, height auto, axis/ticks/years hidden, frames become hairline-separated rows beside a vertical hairline. Talk unpinned, height auto (56px foot like Build and Ship), static band with one address at clamp(40px, 11vw, 64px) breaking after the @, channels in a 2x2 bracketed grid, sign-off last. Prove unpinned, height auto (72px head / 56px foot), word 40px above the shelves, shelves 96px apart, each row a snapping horizontal scroller with objects at scale(0.8), tag rendered under the shelf.

breakpoints.name: pin
breakpoints.purpose: min-width (with prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference): stages pin and scrub, by steps (Build), by distance (Ship strip, Talk band) or by reveal (Prove shelves; Prove also needs min-height 741px).

breakpoints.name: pin-height
breakpoints.purpose: min-height (with min-width 721px and no-preference): Prove pins as one 100svh viewport (72px head, 40px foot, word 32px above the shelves, shelf gap clamp(48px, 9svh, 110px)). Below it the stage flows at min-height 100svh (104px head / 96px foot, shelves 120px apart) and reveals once per shelf.

breakpoints.name: compact-height
breakpoints.purpose: Pinned desktop band where Prove.'s word takes the compact display step clamp(96px, 11vw, 150px) and its objects zoom 0.85 so three shelves fit the viewport.

grain.implementation: Generated <canvas> white-noise greyscale field, regenerated on resize via ResizeObserver, static otherwise. Every stage mounts its own.
grain.zIndex: 2 (Hero, above photo and veil) / 1 (Build, above the print; Ship, above the ground, under the transparent frames; Prove, above the ground, under the boards, objects and tags; Talk, above the ground, under the band's hairlines); always below text. The Prove tag body (z-index 3, ground fill) is the one element above the grain.
grain.note: Direction contract said ~10%; the build ships 0.14. Build wins.

photograph.grading: Left field and frame edges burned to #0b0b0b in the asset; no CSS vignette on desktop.
photograph.mobile: 66svh band, object-position: 78% 0, CSS veil linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(11,11,11,0) 55%, rgba(11,11,11,1) 100%)

prints.source: Screenshot of the product's own public landing at 1000x900 (headless Chromium), 2026-09-13.
prints.grading: Greyscale, contrast 1.06, brightness 0.96, blacks lifted to #0b0b0b, edges burned toward #0b0b0b with per-landing strength (dark landings left 0.8 / right 0.7 / top 0.5 / bottom 0.6 over 10% / 6% / 5% / 8%; Sincerin no top burn because its nav bar is white; Strickle, light, 0.28 / 0.22 / 0 / 0.3). JPEG q0.86.
prints.provenance: Recipe embedded in each JPEG COM segment and in .impeccable/prints-provenance.txt.
prints.rule: The Graded Print Rule: any raster on a stage is greyscale, blacks lifted to ground, edges burned toward ground with a strength chosen per image, provenance embedded.
prints.window: figure, overflow hidden, background ground; fill + object-fit cover, object-position per project (50% 0). Desktop: right half of the spread, 104px top / 64px bottom, bleeding to the right edge. Mobile: aspect-ratio 4/3 inset by the gutter.

objects.implementation: Six inline SVG line drawings in src/components/prove/objects.tsx: trophy 92×96, medal 72×84, cassette 104×66, book 72×86, floppy 84×78, diploma 100×94 (viewBox = box).
objects.stroke: fill none; stroke currentColor 1px; round caps and joins; hatching var(--mute) 0.75px; ruled text lines on diploma, book and floppy var(--mute) 1px
objects.states: ink at rest; #fff on hover and while the tag is open (hatching stays mute); focus 1px ink outline offset 4px
objects.scale: 1:1 on desktop above 820px of height; zoom 0.85 at 741–820px pinned; transform scale(0.8) from bottom center on phones
objects.rule: Any object standing on a stage is drawn, not pictured: no fill, no raster, no icon font, no caption; its name lives in its hanging tag.

browserSurfaces.focusVisible: outline: 1px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 4px (the full-bleed Talk band uses outline-offset: -1px so the ring is not clipped)
browserSurfaces.scrollbar: width 8px; track var(--bg); thumb var(--line); scrollbar-width: thin

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Top bar: DZ mark left, five bracketed stage links centred, right column empty on desktop.
components.html:
DZ
  • [ Build ]
  • [ Ship ]
  • [ Prove ]
  • [ Live ]
  • [ Talk ]
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; align-items: center; padding: 28px clamp(20px, 4vw, 48px); background: var(--bg, #0b0b0b); font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav-list { display: flex; gap: 22px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-nav a { color: var(--mute, #8f8d86); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #fff; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ink, #efede8); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-nav-mark { color: var(--ink, #efede8) !important; font-weight: 500; justify-self: start; }

components.name: Bracketed Link
components.description: The only control: text typed in brackets, mute at rest, pure white on hover, no box.
components.css: .ds-bracket { display: inline-block; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--mute, #8f8d86); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-bracket:hover { color: #fff; } .ds-bracket:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ink, #efede8); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Descriptor
components.description: The one mono sentence above the stage word.
components.html: Blockchain developer · ZK · privacy. I build systems that prove without revealing. Cali, Colombia.
components.css: .ds-descriptor { margin: 0; max-width: 54ch; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-weight: 400; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--mute, #8f8d86); }

components.name: Scroll Cue
components.description: 44x72 hit area with a 1px line fading from transparent to ink; links to the next stage.
components.css: .ds-cue { display: grid; justify-items: center; align-items: end; width: 44px; height: 72px; } .ds-cue span { width: 1px; height: 56px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, var(--ink, #efede8)); } .ds-cue:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ink, #efede8); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Display Word
components.description: The stage word in Anton. Hero: the name, two lines; Build: `Build.`, one line. Steps to the mobile size at 720px.
components.css: .ds-name, .ds-word { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-display, Anton, Impact, sans-serif); font-weight: 400; font-size: clamp(96px, 13vw, 200px); line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: 0.005em; color: var(--ink, #efede8); } .ds-name { text-wrap: balance; } .ds-name span { display: block; } @media (max-width: 720px) { .ds-name, .ds-word { font-size: clamp(84px, 24vw, 110px); } }

components.name: Index Row
components.description: Project row in the Build index: name and scope on one baseline between hairlines; mute at rest, white on hover, ink when active. Bracketed 2x2 grid on mobile.
components.css: .ds-index { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; background: var(--bg, #0b0b0b); } .ds-index li { border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #262624); } .ds-index li:last-child { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #262624); } .ds-row { all: unset; box-sizing: border-box; cursor: pointer; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; align-items: baseline; gap: 24px; width: 100%; padding: 18px 0; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--mute, #8f8d86); transition: color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-row:hover { color: #fff; } .ds-row[aria-current="true"] { color: var(--ink, #efede8); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ink, #efede8); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-row-meta { font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--mute, #8f8d86); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } @media (max-width: 720px) { .ds-index { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 4px 16px; } .ds-index li, .ds-index li:last-child { border: 0; } .ds-row { width: auto; grid-template-columns: auto; gap: 0; padding: 8px 0; } .ds-row-meta { display: none; } .ds-row-name::before { content: '[ '; } .ds-row-name::after { content: ' ]'; } }

components.name: Print Caption
components.description: Pitch in the descriptor voice and the bracketed [ Visit host ] control on one baseline under a print; stacked on mobile.
components.html:
Zero-knowledge raffles on Avalanche. Pick an alias, join a raffle, and your identity stays yours.

[ Visit raffero.com ]
components.css: .ds-caption { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; align-items: baseline; gap: 24px; background: var(--bg, #0b0b0b); } .ds-pitch { margin: 0; max-width: 54ch; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--mute, #8f8d86); } .ds-visit { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--mute, #8f8d86); text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; transition: color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-visit:hover { color: #fff; } .ds-visit:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ink, #efede8); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 720px) { .ds-caption { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 12px; } }

components.name: Print Window
components.description: Hard-edged window filled with ground; the active graded print develops from near-black on every change.
components.css: .ds-print { position: relative; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; background: var(--bg, #0b0b0b); aspect-ratio: 10 / 9; } .ds-print-img { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: 50% 0; opacity: 0; } .ds-print-img.ds-on { opacity: 1; animation: ds-develop 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } @keyframes ds-develop { from { filter: brightness(0.05) contrast(1.6); } to { filter: brightness(1) contrast(1); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-print-img.ds-on { animation: none; } } @media (max-width: 720px) { .ds-print { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; } }

components.name: Timeline Axis
components.description: Ship's time axis: 1px hairline, one 1px mute tick and a 12px tabular year per stop, year pitch clamp(220px, 22vw, 320px).
components.html:
2019
2020
2021
components.css: .ds-axis-wrap { --year: clamp(220px, 22vw, 320px); position: relative; height: 40px; width: calc(var(--year) * 2 + 48px); background: var(--bg, #0b0b0b); } .ds-axis { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: calc(var(--year) * 2); height: 1px; background: var(--line, #262624); } .ds-year { position: absolute; left: calc(var(--i) * var(--year)); top: 0; } .ds-tick { position: absolute; left: 0; top: -4px; width: 1px; height: 9px; background: var(--mute, #8f8d86); } .ds-year-label { position: absolute; left: 8px; top: 12px; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--mute, #8f8d86); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Frame
components.description: Ship timeline entry: a transparent hairline rectangle with title (ink, 13px), organisation and dates (mute, 12px, tabular), joined to its tick by a 44px leader; a hairline-separated row on mobile.
components.html:
1. Technical ContributorAvalanche Team12024 – present
  2. CTOBuckspay2025 – 2026
components.css: .ds-frames { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 24px; background: var(--bg, #0b0b0b); } .ds-frame { position: relative; width: min(248px, calc(var(--year, 320px) - 16px)); box-sizing: border-box; display: grid; gap: 4px; padding: 14px 16px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #262624); background: transparent; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); } .ds-leader { position: absolute; left: -1px; top: -45px; width: 1px; height: 44px; background: var(--line, #262624); } .ds-frame-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--ink, #efede8); } .ds-frame-meta { font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--mute, #8f8d86); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } @media (max-width: 720px), (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-frames { gap: 0; padding-left: 20px; border-left: 1px solid var(--line, #262624); } .ds-frame { width: auto; padding: 14px 0 16px; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #262624); } .ds-frame:last-child { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #262624); } .ds-leader { display: none; } }

components.name: Shelf
components.description: Prove's signature fixture: drawn objects standing on a double-hairline board with two line brackets beneath and a one-word uppercase label at the right end; a snapping horizontal scroller on mobile.
components.html: Won
components.css: .ds-shelf { position: relative; min-width: 0; padding-bottom: 56px; background: var(--bg, #0b0b0b); } .ds-shelf-label { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 26px; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--mute, #8f8d86); } .ds-shelf-row { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0 40px; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 36px; } .ds-shelf-link { all: unset; cursor: pointer; display: grid; justify-items: center; padding: 8px 8px 0; color: var(--ink, #efede8); } .ds-shelf-link:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ink, #efede8); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-object { display: block; color: var(--ink, #efede8); transition: color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-shelf-item:hover .ds-object { color: #fff; } .ds-board { position: relative; height: 4px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #262624); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #262624); } .ds-bracket { position: absolute; top: 4px; left: 48px; display: block; } .ds-bracket-right { left: auto; right: 48px; transform: scaleX(-1); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-object { transition: none; } } @media (max-width: 720px) { .ds-shelf-row { max-width: 100%; padding: 0 8px; gap: 32px; overflow-x: auto; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; scrollbar-width: none; } .ds-shelf-row::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; } .ds-shelf-item { scroll-snap-align: start; flex: 0 0 auto; } .ds-object { transform: scale(0.8); transform-origin: bottom center; } }

components.name: Hanging Tag
components.description: Prove's annotation: a 16px thread from the object and a one-line hairline body with the name in ink, detail · year in mute and [ Open ] when a URL exists; hidden at rest, drops in on hover / focus / first tap; renders under the shelf on phones.
components.html: Bootcamp AvalancheTeam1 Latam · YouTube · 2025[ Open ]
components.css: .ds-tag-demo { position: relative; height: 80px; background: var(--bg, #0b0b0b); } .ds-tag { position: absolute; z-index: 3; left: 50%; top: 0; translate: -50% 0; display: grid; justify-items: center; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-8px); transition: opacity 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-tag-open { opacity: 1; transform: none; } .ds-thread { width: 1px; height: 16px; background: var(--line, #262624); } .ds-tag-body { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; column-gap: 14px; row-gap: 2px; align-items: baseline; width: max-content; max-width: min(60ch, 80vw); padding: 9px 14px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #262624); background: var(--bg, #0b0b0b); font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--mute, #8f8d86); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-tag-name { color: var(--ink, #efede8); } .ds-tag-verify { letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-tag { transition: none; transform: none; } } @media (max-width: 720px) { .ds-tag { position: static; translate: none; display: block; margin-top: 48px; } .ds-tag-body { width: auto; max-width: 100%; white-space: normal; } .ds-tag-meta { white-space: nowrap; } }

components.name: Email Band
components.description: Talk's signature control: the address in Anton at the Band step, repeated with mute em-dash separators between two full-bleed hairlines; one mailto link, ink at rest, white on hover, inset focus ring; scrubbed by scroll on desktop, static and wrapping after the @ on mobile.
components.html: iam@davidzo.com—iam@davidzo.com—iam@davidzo.com

narrative.northStar: La Copia de Cámara Oscura (The Darkroom Print)
narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "La Copia de Cámara Oscura" (The Darkroom Print)**

The site is a print pulled from a darkroom, not a web page with a photo on it. One person, one word, and everything else is darkness and grain. The photograph is the argument; the name is the caption. There is no color anywhere: the whole world lives between a near-black ground and a warm paper white, with a single grey for anything that speaks second and a hairline that is barely lighter than the ground. Depth comes from the photograph's own burned edges and a generated silver-gelatin grain, never from CSS gradients, glass, or shadows.

Density is extremely low and deliberate. A stage is a single viewport with a handful of elements, each anchored to an edge or a gutter, and large areas of ground left empty on purpose. Type does the work of hierarchy: a condensed heavy display face at poster scale against small, widely tracked monospace annotations. Body text in Archivo is loaded and reserved but has not yet appeared on a surface; the five shipped stages (Hero, Build, Ship, Prove, Talk) are entirely display and mono, plus, in Prove, line drawing: the vitrine's objects are 1px stroke drawings in ink with fine mute hatching, no fills, no raster, no icon font.

Motion is either a print developing or the visitor's own scroll. On load the Hero print "develops" once (1.6s, exponential ease-out) from near-black to its true tones while the caption settles into place. From the second stage on, the page is a sequence of pinned viewports scrubbed by scroll: the Hero's print sinks back into the ground as it leaves, each change of print inside the Build spread is the same 1.6s develop again, and the Ship strip is dragged right-to-left by the scroll while its axis draws once (1.2s, exponential ease-out) on entry; the closing Talk stage drags its email band the same way, and nothing on it animates but that drag. Prove, between Ship and Talk, is the third scrubbed grammar: the pinned stage reveals its three shelves one after another as the visitor scrolls (each board draws from the left, its objects are set down, its label comes up), and once the last shelf is set the pin holds a short beat and releases. Nothing moves on its own; every motion is tied to load, scroll position, or a hover. The resting state is complete without JavaScript and is shown immediately under `prefers-reduced-motion`, which removes smoothing, pinning and the develop. The product commits to six stages, one word each (Hero, Build, Ship, Prove, Live, Talk); Talk, the closing stage, was built and mounted before Prove; Prove (the trophy vitrine) shipped as an extension of this world, and the one remaining stage (Live) inherits it rather than opening a new one.
keyCharacteristics: Black and white only; no color accent exists in the token set.
One dark ground, one ink, one grey, one hairline; nothing in between.
Poster-scale condensed display word against 12–13px tracked monospace annotations.
Flat: no shadows, no CSS vignette on desktop, no radius; edges are the composition.
Generated grain over the whole stage (`mix-blend-mode: overlay`, opacity 0.14).
Every raster is a graded print: greyscale, blacks lifted to ground, edges burned to ground in the asset.
Motion is the develop (1.6s) or the scroll; nothing animates on its own.
Objects are drawn, not pictured: 1px `currentColor` strokes with round joins and 0.75px mute hatching, no fills; never a raster icon or a glyph font.

rules.name: The No-Accent Rule
rules.body: There is no fifth colour. Emphasis is produced by scale (display vs mono), by value (ink vs mute), or by state (mute → pure white), never by hue.

rules.name: The Burned-In Rule
rules.body: Darkness belongs to the raster. Grading, vignette and the desktop left-field fade live in the image; CSS carries no gradient on desktop. The one CSS fade (the mobile foot veil, `linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 55%, ground 100%)`) exists only where the portrait crop must land on solid ground.

rules.name: The Graded Print Rule
rules.body: Any raster placed on a stage is a print, not a screenshot: converted to greyscale, blacks lifted to `{colors.ground}` so the image never goes darker than the page, and its edges burned toward `{colors.ground}` with a strength chosen per image (heavier on dark sources, lighter on light ones, no burn on an edge that would swallow a white bar), with the grading recipe embedded in the file's own metadata. Colour or an unburned raster never ships.

rules.name: The One Word Rule
rules.body: Each stage owns exactly one display-scale word; everything else on the stage is 12–13px monospace. A stage with two display-scale elements has broken the world. The one recorded exception is the Talk band: the email address is set in the display face at the smaller Band step because the address is the stage's action, not a second word; it earns the face by being the thing the visitor came to do, and no other stage may borrow the step for a headline.

rules.name: The Uppercase-Is-Control Rule
rules.body: Uppercase with 0.14em tracking is the voice of bracketed navigation and action links (`[ Build ]`, `[ Talk ]`, `[ Visit raffero.com ]`, `[ Open ]`) only. Descriptor, index and data lines stay in sentence case at 0.06–0.08em, even when they are typed in brackets on mobile. The one recorded exception is the shelf label under a Prove board (`Won`, `Shared`, `Certified`): a one-word engraving at the edge of a fixture, mute, never bracketed, never a link; it may not be borrowed as a kicker, eyebrow or section heading anywhere else.

rules.name: The Three Pins Rule
rules.body: A pinned stage is scrubbed by steps (Build: pin length `innerHeight × steps`, active step = `floor(progress × steps)`), by distance (Ship and Talk: pin length `distance × 1.2` with a floor of `innerHeight × 0.6`, track translated by that distance), or by reveal (Prove: pin length `innerHeight × (0.7 × shelves + 0.4)`, a scrubbed timeline that sets the stage's content down piece by piece and ends on a 0.6s beat). The reveal exists because Prove's whole content fits one viewport, so there is nothing to step or drag; it is not for stages that have. All three start `top top`, all `scrub: true`, all vanish at 720px and under `prefers-reduced-motion`, where the stage becomes an ordinary flowing section; the reveal additionally requires 741px of height and otherwise plays once per piece on entry. A fourth pin grammar needs a reason these three cannot serve.

rules.name: The Flat Print Rule
rules.body: No `box-shadow`, no `backdrop-filter`, no glass, no elevation states. If an element needs separation, it gets a 1px hairline (`{colors.line}`) or more empty ground, never a shadow.

rules.name: The Grain Is Material Rule
rules.body: The grain is one static field over the whole stage, regenerated only on resize. Every stage mounts its own Grain canvas at the same opacity and blend; it is never animated, never tiled per element, and never applied to text alone.

dos: Do keep every stage to one display-scale word in Anton (`clamp(96px, 13vw, 200px)`, stepping to `clamp(84px, 24vw, 110px)` at 720px and below) and 12–13px JetBrains Mono for everything else.
Do anchor elements to edges and the gutter (`clamp(20px, 4vw, 48px)`); leave the rest of the stage as ground.

Do use `{colors.mute}` for every secondary voice and `{colors.line}` for every 1px rule (the one exception: a tick that crosses a line-coloured axis is 1px `{colors.mute}`); use pure white only as a hover state.

Do put darkness into the raster (greyscale, blacks lifted to `#0b0b0b`, edges burned toward it in the asset, recipe embedded) and keep the grain canvas over the whole stage at opacity 0.14 with `overlay` blending.
Do ship the resting state complete without JavaScript, and disable smoothing, pinning, the hero exit and the develop under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do type controls as bracketed text (`[ Word ]`) with a 200ms colour step on hover and the global 1px ink focus outline; mark the active item by stepping it to ink, nothing else.

Do reuse the develop (1.6s, `brightness(0.05) contrast(1.6)` → true tones, `--ease-out`) for any print that changes on a stage, and drive stage progress from scroll position (pin + scrub, by steps, by distance or by reveal) rather than from timers.

Do draw any object that stands on a stage as a line drawing: `fill: none`, 1px `currentColor` stroke with round caps and joins, 0.75px `{colors.mute}` hatching for volume, ink at rest and pure white on hover; set its foot on a hairline and put its name in a hanging tag, never in a caption under it.

Do give a pinned stage that must hold everything in one viewport its own height floor (741px) and, when the viewport is short (741–820px), the compact display step (`clamp(96px, 11vw, 150px)`) with objects at `zoom: 0.85`; below the floor, unpin and let it flow.

Do keep any hairline rectangle transparent and around data only (a Ship frame), and collapse it to hairline-separated rows on mobile and under reduced motion; never box a control. The Talk band is not a box: its two rules run full-bleed and never close at the sides.

Do set a stage's single action in the display face only at the Band step (`clamp(64px, 8.5vw, 120px)`, `clamp(40px, 11vw, 64px)` on mobile and under reduced motion) between two hairlines, as the Talk email band does; a full-bleed control takes its focus ring inset (`outline-offset: -1px`) so the ring is never clipped.
Do keep the site free of trackers and third-party scripts as a build rule, silently: the sign-off reads `© {year} David Zapata · davidzo.com` and nothing more.
donts: Don't introduce any hue: no accent colour, no tinted greys, no coloured links or focus rings.
Don't use `box-shadow`, `backdrop-filter`, glass, or CSS gradients on desktop; the only permitted gradient is the mobile foot veil and the 1px scroll cue.
Don't round any corner or draw any box around a control.
Don't cover the finger-on-lips gesture with text at any breakpoint.
Don't uppercase anything except bracketed navigation and action links, and never track the descriptor beyond 0.08em.
Don't animate anything on its own after load; motion is the develop, the scroll-scrubbed pin and hero exit, the once-only axis draw on entry, or the 200ms hover colour step. The grain never moves.
Don't place a colour screenshot, an unburned raster, or a raster without its provenance on a stage.
Don't print a "no trackers" (or any privacy) claim as copy anywhere on the site; the user removed it from the sign-off. Privacy is demonstrated by the build, not announced.
Don't borrow the Band step for a headline or a second word on any stage; it exists for the one address on Talk.

Don't caption, fill, colour, or replace with a raster or icon-font glyph any shelf object; and don't reuse the shelf label's uppercase for a kicker, eyebrow or heading. The label is an engraving on a fixture, not a type role.
Don't let a phone page scroll sideways: a row that overflows scrolls inside itself (`overflow-x: auto`, snap) with `min-width: 0` on its ancestors.
